tagline: 理光数码相机，2005 年发布
description: 理光于2005年推出的数码相机。配备Focal length f:5.8-17.4mm (equivalent to 28-85mm for 35mm film cameras), Lens structure 9 glass elements in 7 groups.。快门速度Still 30, 15, 8, 4, 2, 1-1/2000 sec (electronic/mechanical shutter), During long-term exposure, has noise Elimination function.。感光度Auto, ISO64, ISO100, ISO200, ISO400, ISO800, ISO1600。Autofocus, Manual Focus, Fixed Focus (Snap), ∞ (includes AF auxiliary light)。
